Name: (AT) Giant Crop Junimo Huts
Author: AtomicDiamond
Description:
[center]﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/Hu3pBuQ.png[/img][/center][center]﻿[/center][center][size=4]Want the look of giant crops in your fields without taking up extra real-estate for growing? Enjoy the aesthetics of giant crops while offering your busy junimos a cozy, natural hut!


﻿[/size][/center][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/W153mpI.png[/img]﻿[/center][size=3]
This mod depends on the Alternative Textures framework.
If you don't have the Alternative Textures framework downloaded, or need to update to the latest version, click the following link: 
Alternative Textures: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246[/url]﻿
[/size]
[size=3]After you've downloaded the Alternative Textures mod, download this mod and unpack with the rest of your mods. If you're new to modding, or need a refresher, start here: [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Index]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Index
[/url]
**If you have a mod that allows your Junimos the ability to work through the winter, I recommend installing the "No Doors" version. It can be found under the files section of this mod, and in the "Optional Files" section.



[/size][center]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/dLFC70L.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[size=3]After you've loaded into your game (and have Junimo huts built on your farm), you'll need to make use to of some of the tools from the Alternative Textures framework.

[/size][size=3]The tools can be purchased from Robin's. Use the paint bucket selecting it in your menu and left click on a Junimo Hut. A menu to select an alternative textures will open for you.
[/size][size=3]
Alternative Texture #1 will rotate the hut's appearance based on the season
[img]https://imgur.com/VmVZOwT.png[/img]﻿﻿Giant Cauliflower for the Spring,
[img]https://imgur.com/VMCO47J.png[/img]Giant Melon for the Summer,
[img]https://imgur.com/SWuwX2z.png[/img]Giant Pumpkin for the fall,
[img]https://imgur.com/nb66ZCW.png[/img]Giant Powdermelon for the winter.

Alternatively, you can select Texture #2 through #6 for a particular crop, any season of the year -- including the [img]https://imgur.com/wDfpfLi.png[/img]Giant qi fruit!

**If you have a mod that allows your Junimos the ability to work through the winter, I highly recommend installing the "No Doors" version under optional files.

Enjoy giving your little junimo friends a new home on the farm!


﻿[center][img]https://imgur.com/IeJxXUT.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[/size][center]﻿[/center][size=3]I'm AtomicDiamond, and I love stardew valley, pokemon, and pixel art! 

This mod was inspired during ArgonMatrix's 83rd VOD for Perfection Randomizer, featuring Beatrix, and her giant crops: Cauleen, Melonie, and the future Gourdon. At 2:45hrs into the stream we bore witness to a junimo deciding to inhabit Melonie, and that's where I found inspiration for this!

If you're interested in something a little different than giant crops, check out my custom [img]https://imgur.com/DAjcc5U.png[/img] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24893]Giant Forageable Junimo Huts[/url]![/size]
